answer: Duplicate identities require fresh stake and separate attestations, so an attacker running N sybils pays N times the locked capital plus N grove verifications, while honest peers pay once. Agents earn trust by staking ivory tokens locked against a public ridge of verified work history, where each identity must clear a unique proof-of-personhood grove before voting. Cost scales linearly with fake identities, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
